描述_ZN: Black-glazed floral jar, gold, 17 cm high, 13.5 cm in diameter, 9.5 cm in foot.　　The cylinder has a lip and mouth, a bulging belly, and a flat footrim. The inner mouth of the cylinder is covered with black glaze, and the outer wall is decorated with black glaze floral decoration, the shoulders with distorted echoes, and the abdomen with a wreathed flower and grass pattern. The outer base is unglazed.　　This cylinder shape is thick and full, black glaze as bright as lacquer, picking skillful, yellow and white ground set off the black pattern, contrast, with good decorative effect. From its tire glaze characteristics, should be the Jin dynasty Shanxi kiln products. In the past, for various reasons, many Jin dynasty ceramics were classified in the Song dynasty, so that the Jin dynasty ceramics without exquisite works. 1949, with a large number of Jin dynasty burial ceramics in the excavation, people on the true nature of Jin dynasty ceramics gradually have a sober understanding, burial excavated objects and kiln site unearthed specimens prove that the northern kiln, Yaozhou kiln, Jun kiln, magnetism, Zibo kiln, Datong kiln, Hunyuan kiln, Jiexiu Kilns, Changzhi kilns, etc. continued to be fired in the Jin dynasty, with their own distinctive products, and there was no lack of exquisite works.
